title: Marketplace areas share one pinned nav: Classifieds, Housing, Market and Store swap content beneath it
detail:
Under the Frequency design a pinned area nav (components/frequency/members/marketplace/area-nav.tsx) is mounted by the Classifieds, Housing, Market and new Store layouts through MarketAreaPin. It sticks under the app header and reads the active door from the URL, so soft navigation re-highlights it and each route's loading skeleton fills only the space below. The page bodies and MarketplaceBar no longer draw their own area row there. Honest gap: the four subtrees are separate layouts, so the bar re-mounts (identical, sticky) when crossing areas; a single route-group layout would keep one instance and needs a 40+ file directory move, filed as a follow-up if it shows.

Pinned area nav in four layouts
